name: Zaiakukan "Onegai... Konna Sugata Minaide"
original_name: 罪悪感 「お願い…こんな姿見ないで」
source:
Main character is a young businessman who can only get excited with someone else's wife or bride. So far he has never been caught, but these occasional acts can not satisfy him. His relative is getting married, and protagonist decides to trample the bride in front of the groom. To do that he invites the couple to his luxury liner for honeymoon... to the place with no escape...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-january-2002.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公是一名年轻商人，只有面对别人的妻子或新娘时才会兴奋。至今他从未被抓住，但偶尔为之已经无法满足他。一名亲戚即将结婚，主人公决定当着新郎的面蹂躏新娘。为此，他邀请这对新人登上自己的豪华游艇度蜜月…前往一个无处可逃的地方…

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-january-2002.html]vndbreview[/url]]
